'''TVS Holdings Limited''', is an Indian automotive components company, based in [[Chennai]]. Part of the [[TVS Group]], it makes aluminium and magnesium castings for the automotive industry.<ref>{{cite news |title=TVS Group's Sundaram Clayton embarks on internal rejig to unlock value |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/tvs-groups-sundaram-clayton-embarks-on-internal-rejig-to-unlock-value-8066551.html |access-date=15 March 2023 |work=Moneycontrol |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Chandrashekhar |first1=Anandi |title=Sundaram-Clayton inaugurates new foundry in Chennai to expand capacity |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/auto/auto-news/sundaram-clayton-inaugurates-new-foundry-in-chennai-to-expand-capacity/articleshow/66168100.cms |access-date=15 March 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=11 October 2018}}</ref> It was the flagship company of the TVS Group before being overtaken by its subsidiary [[TVS Motor Company]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2022-02-10|title=R Gopalan Appointed as Chairman of the Board of Sundaram-Clayton Limited|url=https://www.rashtranews.com/r-gopalan-appointed-as-chairman-of-the-board-of-sundaram-clayton-limited/|access-date=2022-02-18|website=Rashtranews.com|language=en-US}}</ref>

The company was founded as Sundaram-Clayton Ltd in 1962 in collaboration with Clayton Dewandre Holdings plc, United Kingdom. It was renamed TVS Holdings Ltd in 2023 after the amalgamation of TVS Holdings Pvt Ltd into the company.<ref name="renamed">{{cite news |title=Sundaram Clayton renamed TVS Holdings Ltd. |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/sundaram-clayton-renamed-tvs-holdings-ltd/article67097708.ece |access-date=11 April 2024 |work=The Hindu |date=19 July 2023 |language=en-IN}}</ref>

In May 2024, TVS Holdings acquired an 80.74% stake in Home Credit India.<ref>{{cite news |title=TVS Holdings to acquire majority stake in Home Credit India for ₹554 crore |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/tvs-holdings-to-acquire-majority-stake-in-home-credit-india-for-554-crore-11715345111927.html |access-date=20 August 2024 |work=Mint}}</ref>

TVS Holdings Limited, is an Indian automotive components company, based in Chennai. Part of the TVS Group, it makes aluminium and magnesium castings for the automotive industry. It was the flagship company of the TVS Group before being overtaken by its subsidiary TVS Motor Company.
The company was founded as Sundaram-Clayton Ltd in 1962 in collaboration with Clayton Dewandre Holdings plc, United Kingdom. It was renamed TVS Holdings Ltd in 2023 after the amalgamation of TVS Holdings Pvt Ltd into the company.
In May 2024, TVS Holdings acquired an 80.74% stake in Home Credit India.
